name: stripe-failed-charge
prompt: A Stripe charge failed. Event: {event.type}. Customer: {data.object.customer}. Amount: {data.object.amount}. Failure code: {data.object.failure_code}. Pull the customer's full Stripe state (read-only) and recent activity. Pull their CS health score from business/knowledge-base/. Post to #finance: (1) account size (MRR), (2) failure reason, (3) recommended action: silent-retry | dunning sequence | personal outreach. If MRR > $500, also DM the founder and draft a personal outreach email per business/sops/_shared/approval-gate.md.
